en: We have reached the morning and at this very time the dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner.
O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil — Ayatul Kursi: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer.
O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can.
We have reached the evening and at this very time the dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

O Allah, I have reached the evening and call on You to witness, and Your angels and all Your creation, that You are Allah, none worthy of worship but You, and Muhammad ﷺ is Your servant and messenger.
In the name of Allah.
All praise is to Allah Who has given me this food and provided it for me, without any strength or power on my part.
In the name of Allah at its beginning and at its end. (Said when one forgets Bismillah before eating)
Glory be to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it by our efforts. And to our Lord we shall return.
O Allah, we ask You on this journey for goodness and piety, and for works that are pleasing to You.
In Your name O Allah, I die and I live.
O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day You resurrect Your servants.
Recite Surah Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas — then blow into your hands and wipe over your body (3 times).
O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.
O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.
O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer to be offered, grant Muhammad ﷺ the privilege and the eminence.
I seek forgiveness from Allah the Mighty, Whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Living, the Eternal, and I repent to Him.
O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim.
Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the Fire.
Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the Best Disposer of Affairs.
Indeed, to Allah we belong and to Him we shall return.
